fixtures.syntheticSetup: Synthetic matrix of spec-frozen server/local error categories with state snapshots, plus opaque raw OS/provider causes whose category and user copy remain OPEN_QUESTION.
fixtures.plannedAction: Inject each selected frozen error at its named branch and observe the contract-prescribed client action and state preservation; do not assign a category or UI copy to opaque platform/provider causes.
observableAssertions: INVALID_DTO keeps the draft and stops that op; IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH stops the op without minting a replacement opId; conflict/delete errors retain the draft for head/conflict handling.
EPOCH_MISMATCH/CURSOR_EXPIRED triggers snapshot recovery while preserving the draft and not directly replaying old outbox bytes.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED/TEMP_STORAGE_FULL/OBJECT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED block new positive delta while read/delete/export remain available; STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE/DB_BUSY retries the original opId and bytes and never reports an uncommitted op as committed.
CIPHER_INTEGRITY_FAILED isolates the copy and never auto-pastes it; local key/vault/SQLCipher failures preserve the original database evidence and never fall back to plaintext SQLite.
Only frozen retryable distinctions are asserted; unknown raw OS/provider causes and user-facing copy remain OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Synthetic cancellation at known pre-commit, in-flight/unknown-result, process interruption while SENDING, and known post-commit boundaries; terminal wording for unfrozen cases is left open.
fixtures.plannedAction: Cancel each controlled branch, snapshot operation bytes/state before and after, query a receipt where commit outcome is unknown, and resume only using the frozen reconciliation path.
observableAssertions: Known pre-commit cancellation produces no committed mutation; a request with unknown commit outcome is reconciled by its original opId/receipt and is never blindly replayed as a new op.
After process interruption, SENDING returns to READY with identical wire_bytes; committed receipt/revision/seq are retained and cancellation cannot roll back a committed mutation.
Assert accepted/too-late labels only where a contract freezes them; unspecified cancel result mapping/copy remains OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Synthetic local/outbox/cloud/capture/share/decoded-cache counters at below/exact/above boundaries using only limits.v1.json and accepted accounting; local durable-byte formula and native-share cap remain OPEN_QUESTION.
fixtures.plannedAction: Exercise positive-delta writes and protected read/delete/export across frozen budget boundaries; compare accounting snapshots and retry after capacity is freed only where the spec defines that transition.
observableAssertions: Frozen local/cloud/outbox limits block the affected new mutation with only their specified category; reads/deletes/exports remain available where specified.
Saved, pinned, trash, and draft data remain intact; no silent scope conversion, queue loss, or implicit provider entitlement change occurs.
Use frozen accounting and limit keys only; do not invent local byte formulas, share caps, or native cache charge categories.
